package.author: Behnam Yousefi
package.description: A correct, deterministic, cross-platform terminal emulator with a cell-based VT engine, deterministic session replay, and native SSH.

en-US.author: Behnam Yousefi
en-US.description: A correct, deterministic, cross-platform terminal emulator with a cell-based VT engine, deterministic session replay, and native SSH.
en-US.longDescription:
Ntilde is a cross-platform terminal emulator built on a cell-based virtual-terminal
engine with strong VT/ANSI conformance, deterministic session recording and replay, and a
native SSH client (profiles, jump hosts, port forwarding). It is self-contained: this package
is a portable build extracted from the official release archive and runs without an installer.
en-US.name: Ntilde
